sentences.english_text: The assistant picked up the cage and carried it backstage next to the curtain where it was out of sight of the audience.
The theater was now filling with people.
It was the sound of the orchestra playing that awakened Drippy.
The music was very loud and he could not sleep.
He sat up and sleepily looked around wondering where he was.
And then he remembered he was in the rabbit's ear.
He remembered the little girl and the rainbow and the spider.
Drippy slid out of the rabbit's ear and out of the cage.
I've got to get out of this place.
It's time for another adventure.
He saw what looked like a long narrow room and he started rolling across it.
When he was halfway across a huge curtain suddenly opened and the audience began to applaud.
Drippy did not know it, but he was in the middle of the stage.
The show was about to begin.
Drippy stood there stunned as he saw the thousands of people who seemed to be staring at him.
They're applauding me.
I must be the star of the show.
But Drippy had no idea what he was supposed to do.
They've all paid money to see me.
